provenance.asset_description: Illustration by Alexander Gorbunov: Kyyduh, a cat-like humanoid with six eyes, stands tall, wearing an armored chest plate. a large claw-like blade extends from their right wrist, while their left arm forms into a glowing opening that resembles a canon.
